name: app-ai-workout-builder-dark-with-gradient-phones
title: AI workout builder on black with peach and violet gradient screens
whatItIs: A near-black board with a centred paragraph in two-tone type and three phones: a dark screen with a lilac to peach AI card, a peach gradient screen with a glowing orb and 'Create a stronger life', and a violet to white chat screen with fading suggestion lines and an 'Ask anything' pill.
whatItMeans: Futuristic yet warm; gradients give the AI a soft personality.
techniques: Give each screen its own gradient (peach, violet) on a black presentation to make them glow.
Use a soft glass orb as the emblem of an AI.
Let suggestion prompts fade out towards the bottom to imply scroll and depth.
Place tags as small pills inside a gradient card.

vocabulary.definition: A screen using a full-bleed colour gradient as background.
A list whose items fade toward an edge.
A recurring shape that represents the assistant.
A rounded text field with an icon.
